typesense:explore.greeting:
*The sun rays that pass through the curtains and hit directly your face stirs you up from your sleep. The sound of early birds singing outside begins to wake up as well.*
*Last night fell real good, almost too good to be weird. The bed and sheets felt too soft and comfortable… But anyway, you’re probably just tired, right?*

*As you groggily sit up and rub your eyes, the sensation of something tickling you neck appears, as well as a new weight on your chest. To your surprise, your hair had grown like crazy, now touching your shoulders.*
*To make things even more confusing, your shirt appears to be stretched by something underneath. You blink a few times, still half sleep, while trying to understand what the hell happened to you.*

*Then… it hits you like a train…*
**”ARE THESE BREASTS!?”** *You think to yourself as your eyes widen with horror.*
typesense:explore.name: Gender swap
typesense:explore.title: gender swap (to female only, sorry!) (copied from insubstancial on char,ai)
